messages:
Maya (CSM): FYI Sparrow embed onboarding spiked ~3x overnight, triggered our daily spend alert.
Owen (FinOps): saw the alert, applying a soft throttle; will post a quick spend breakdown. :eyes:
billing-bot: ALERT: account=sparrow metric=daily_spend value=4.1x threshold=2.0x ts=2026-03-22T21:12:03Z
Raj (AE): renewal is Jun 1 — this spike could raise friction. need a concise remediation plan for the QBR.
Linh (OnboardEng): digging into onboarding logs: they flipped to dense embeddings and are sending many tiny requests (batch_size=1). also seeing repeated near-duplicate vectors causing recompute.
Casey (Product): if it's high-QPS tiny batches, batching + async ingestion should help. can we share a copy-paste client snippet?
Maya (CSM): proposed immediate plan: (1) 24h temporary rate cap, (2) client-side batching patch, (3) offer INT8 quantized embedding variant as a cheaper fallback, (4) 30m enablement call tomorrow to balance freshness vs cost.
Owen (FinOps): agree. temp throttle = 50 rps on embeddings route for 24h. proposing $5k retainer credit to smooth QBR — will escalate to finance.
Linh (OnboardEng): quick batching example to share:
``n# pseudo-client batching
queue = []
def enqueue(item):
  queue.append(item)
  if len(queue) >= 128 or time_since(last_flush) > 0.5:
    send_batch(queue)
    queue.clear()
```
Also increasing KV cache for their Dedicated pool to avoid recompute on repeats.
Raj (AE): retainer credit sounds good, I'll own the ask.
Casey (Product): config tweak: limit embedding context to 512 tokens for background index jobs + prefix caching; reduces per-request tokens.
Maya (CSM): action items: Linh to post exact client patch & rollout steps; Owen to apply throttle & chase finance on credit; Raj to draft QBR slide (incident, mitigation, long-term plan, credit ask); Casey to write quantized-variant blurb with expected savings.
Linh (OnboardEng): patch uploaded to Sparrow onboarding repo (internal link). will paste diff in the invite.
Owen (FinOps): throttle applied at 21:30 UTC. billing-bot will quiet when daily_spend < 2x baseline. tagging account as watch.
Maya (CSM): scheduling 30m enablement tomorrow 15:00 PT — inviting Sparrow ops/dev + Raj + Linh + Owen. add docs to the meeting thread.
Raj (AE): I'll prepare a one-slide QBR readout.
Casey (Product): conservative numbers for slide: batching => ~35% unit cost reduction; quantized embeddings => ~40-50% inference cost delta.
Maya (CSM): customer feedback: Sparrow needs <5s search freshness. we'll validate with a 10% canary and monitor latency, tokens/request, cost/min.
Linh (OnboardEng): canary plan: 10% rollout, dashboard for latency & cost, failback knob.
Owen (FinOps): marking renewal_risk=medium until post-call; updating account-health dashboard.
Maya (CSM): thanks team — I'll send the calendar invite + attach patch + draft slide before EOD. :thumbsup:
